prestige.label: Prestige
prestige.description: Career scoring system measuring sustained league success using championships, pennants, podium finishes, consistency, and other accomplishments.

pennants.label: Pennants
pennants.description: 1st-place finishes in the Regular Season standings.

trophies.label: Trophies
trophies.description: Top-3 playoff finishes: Champion, Runner-Up, or 3rd Place.

playoffAppearances.label: Playoff Appearances
playoffAppearances.description: Seasons in which the owner qualified for the league playoffs.

mostPoints.label: Most Points
mostPoints.description: Highest Regular Season points scored in a season.

leastPoints.label: Least Points
leastPoints.description: Fewest Regular Season points scored in a season.

draftCapital.label: Draft Capital
draftCapital.description: Weighted value assigned to draft selections. Earlier picks receive more value than later picks.

draftCapitalProfile.label: Draft Capital Profile
draftCapitalProfile.description: The percentage of an owner's weighted draft capital spent at each position.

slotImpact.label: Slot Impact
slotImpact.description: How owners performed from a draft slot compared with their own results from every other slot.

slotOverperformance.label: Slot Overperformance
slotOverperformance.description: How an owner performed compared with the historical results of the draft slots they received.

draftArchetype.label: Draft Archetype
draftArchetype.description: A transparent strategy label assigned from draft-capital allocation and positional pick timing. Archetypes may overlap.

quartile.label: Quartile
quartile.description: One of four equally sized spend groups, from the lowest 25% to the highest 25%.

correlation.label: Correlation
correlation.description: A measure of linear association. It can reveal a trend but does not establish causation.

queryBuilder.label: Query Builder
queryBuilder.description: A tool for filtering league draft history by capital allocation and positional pick timing.

tradedSelections.label: Traded Selections
tradedSelections.description: Draft picks made by an owner other than the owner originally assigned that snake-draft slot.

archiveOnly.label: Archive Only
archiveOnly.description: Displayed for historical reference only. The 2017 Yahoo draft archive was entered in lineup order rather than true draft order, so it is excluded from Draft Hub and Draft Lab analysis.

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.description: Total recorded in-season roster moves across league history.

trades.label: Trades
trades.description: Total recorded in-season trades across league history. Draft-day traded selections are tracked separately.

allPlayRecord.label: All-Play Record
allPlayRecord.description: Each weekly score is compared with all nine other teams. Highest earns 9–0, second-highest 8–1, and lowest 0–9.

expectedWins.label: Expected Wins
expectedWins.description: All-play wins divided by nine, converting the all-play record back to a normal head-to-head season scale.

luckDelta.label: Luck Delta
luckDelta.description: Actual wins minus expected wins. Positive means more wins than weekly scoring would predict; negative means fewer.

averageWeeklyRank.label: Average Weekly Rank
averageWeeklyRank.description: Average place among the ten weekly scores. Lower is better.
